title: Regional varieties and the Turkic world
summary: Recognize the varieties around the standard: the main dialect areas of Turkey and the Balkans, well-documented regional features such as *geliyon* and *gız*, Turkish beside its Turkic relatives and their regular sound correspondences, and how to talk about regional speech with tact.
canDo: Name the main dialect areas of Turkey and say how the standard came to rest on Istanbul
Recognize regional forms and words, and say what they are in the standard
Place Turkish among the Turkic languages and recognize shared words through sound correspondences
Talk about accents and related languages without stereotypes
vocabThemes: regional words and their standard equivalents
